name: Nicholas Daum
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Four

items.text: Nicholas Daum is an associate justice on the California Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Four. He was a Los Angeles County Superior Court judge from 2022 to 2026. From 2009 to 2022, he was an associate and partner at Kendall Brill & Kelly. In a 2026 opinion, he affirmed a trial judge’s denial of a new trial, holding the judge could determine the credibility of declarations of juror misconduct.
